mapper.sql: member_no, demand_month, region_code, resource_type, demand_type_code, demand_type_name, demand_type_detail_code, demand_type_detail_name, contract_no, product_code, product_name, instance_no, instance_name, resource_id, resource_name, resource_id_source, usage_unit_code, usage_unit_name, product_price, unit_usage_quantity, total_unit_usage_quantity, use_amount, demand_amount, write_date, pay_currency
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ncp_cost_resource_month ( created, updated, , snapshot_date ) VALUES ( NOW(), NOW(), #{row.memberNo}, #{row.demandMonth}, #{row.regionCode}, #{row.resourceType}, #{row.demandTypeCode}, #{row.demandTypeName}, #{row.demandTypeDetailCode}, #{row.demandTypeDetailName}, #{row.contractNo}, #{row.productCode}, #{row.productName}, #{row.instanceNo}, #{row.instanceName}, #{row.resourceId}, #{row.resourceName}, #{row.resourceIdSource}, #{row.usageUnitCode}, #{row.usageUnitName}, #{row.productPrice}, #{row.unitUsageQuantity}, #{row.totalUnitUsageQuantity}, #{row.useAmount}, #{row.demandAmount}, #{row.writeDate}, #{row.payCurrency}, #{row.snapshotDate} )

INSERT IGNORE INTO ncp_cost_resource_daily ( created, updated, , target_date, daily_charge_amount ) SELECT NOW(), NOW(), today.member_no, today.demand_month, today.region_code, today.resource_type, today.demand_type_code, today.demand_type_name, today.demand_type_detail_code, today.demand_type_detail_name, today.contract_no, today.product_code, today.product_name, today.instance_no, today.instance_name, today.resource_id, today.resource_name, today.resource_id_source, today.usage_unit_code, today.usage_unit_name, today.product_price, today.unit_usage_quantity, today.total_unit_usage_quantity, today.use_amount, today.demand_amount, today.write_date, today.pay_currency, today.snapshot_date AS target_date, today.demand_amount - COALESCE(yesterday.demand_amount, 0) AS daily_charge_amount FROM ncp_cost_resource_month today LEFT JOIN ncp_cost_resource_month yesterday ON yesterday.member_no = today.member_no AND yesterday.demand_month = today.demand_month AND yesterday.resource_type = today.resource_type AND yesterday.resource_id = today.resource_id AND yesterday.region_code = today.region_code AND yesterday.demand_type_detail_code = today.demand_type_detail_code AND yesterday.contract_no = today.contract_no AND yesterday.snapshot_date = today.snapshot_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY WHERE today.member_no = #{row.memberNo} AND today.demand_month = #{row.demandMonth} AND today.resource_type = #{row.resourceType} AND today.resource_id = #{row.resourceId} AND today.region_code = #{row.regionCode} AND today.demand_type_detail_code = #{row.demandTypeDetailCode} AND today.contract_no = #{row.contractNo} AND today.snapshot_date = #{targetDate}
mapper.select: SELECT resource_id FROM ncp_cost_resource_month WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} AND instance_no = #{instanceNo} AND resource_id_source = 'NKS_UUID' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
